name: plate-41-board-tight
version_tag: #137 tighter board wheel (Ron). THREE compounding faults found in the board's fit chain, all fixed: (1) the #114 sleeve-ladder winner (bore 4.17 'id17') was NEVER baked into the real star hub — it still carried 4.35, so on the ~4.09 printed post the board had 0.26mm radial play; hub bore now 4.17 + fixture round post designed AT bore (4.17 -> prints ~4.11) = 0.06. (2) the hub->board PRESS fit was actually 0.06 LOOSE (OD 5.45 design prints 5.39 into a 5.45 bore) — and hub slop in the board bore shifts CENTER DISTANCE straight into the mesh; OD design raised to 5.53 -> prints ~5.47 = 0.02 real interference. (3) bearing was 3.7mm tall against a 42mm rim (11:1 lever); tube extended to 5.0mm (max that clears the key start z8.5). Net rim wobble 2.95mm -> 0.50mm (6x). Fixture r61 also keeps Ron's K4 key (4.42). Board 02h UNCHANGED (plate-40 print is still good — its bore is a bore). NOTE: hub is now a real press fit — expect to tap it into the board. 2 parts, flat, no supports, xy-comp -0.06 MANDATORY. | QUIET.
